content: Scopus API/data has systemic incompleteness: affiliation country/territory frequently missing, affiliation fields sometimes fail to split multiple addresses cleanly, author given names sometimes truncated/missing, and data visible on the Scopus website (e.g. affiliations) can return null via the API. This is a known, persistent issue (not a one-off bug), so integrations must treat every field as potentially absent, not just DOI.
